t: Find the six missing knights in the woods.

It’s been ages that we stayed in this forest. We didn’t mind much, when the elves came. The swamps suited them well, so we decided to let them be. It was alright at first, but then their leader became a widower, and the witch came to ruin the elves, and the swamp, and the whole allod!

So, you’re looking for Annette, right? I’ll help you if you help me. See, I’m alone here. My brothers wander around the forest. I don’t know if they’re lost or got into trouble. I’ve been calling out for them, but all in vain. If you manage to find them, I’ll tell you where your beauty is!
We were in our full powers, as we were young. It’s not like that any longer...

Well now, everyone’s back here. Now listen.

Annette came to stay with us, but she didn’t stay long. We went for a hunt once, and by the time we came back home, she was gone. We figured that it was the damned witch that took our Annette to lock her up, and we strived to save her, but we guess we’re a bit too old for that - we barely escaped! So we have no idea whether she’s alive or not...
I’ve found the place where the old witch locked my beloved! There’s a cave on top of the mountain, she’s in there! Now that the witch is dead, we can save her! Hurry!

Wait! Don’t kill her!

That’s what the old witch was talking about. My dear Annette, my poor girl! As if it wasn’t enough to simply break the back of the beautiful one! She turned her into a monster!

I don’t want to believe that this is the end. If there is a way to lift the curse, I will find it. However, I won’t dare to beg of your help any longer. This is my love, this is my pain. Thank you for everything that you’ve done for us. Now I’m asking you to leave...
Find traces of Annette de Tristesse on the island.

So here’s where the House de Tristesse dwells. This tiny island is corrupted, in and out! My beloved wasn’t born under a happy star...

Ah well, let’s hope for the best. First of all, we need to find elves on this island. I hope they can give us information.
It’s so gloomy and wet, as if the whole island soaked in tears...

The diary goes that the father brought a magic talking mirror as a gift to the stepmother, and she asked, who was the fairest one of all. And the mirror said it was Annette, my beloved! The crazy witch went wild. She decided to kill her! To save her life, Annette had to flee to the forest, to hide at the... wait a minute, what’s that?

Annette kept a journal of her miseries in this notebook. After her mother's death, her father married a noble Kanian woman of the Yagas family. The stepmother turned out to be a selfish, jealous and cruel woman. She abused Annette, mistreated her husband and depressed the whole House.

The notebook doesn't give us a clear notion of what has happened here: it misses half of its pages!
Find Paphnutius Homespun, the village leader.

Welcome! You must be new merchants! What are your goods? Have you brought anything new? Woodcut twilight vampires?

You’ve come to see boyar Jeer, I see. Don’t ask me how to do that - nobody has never met him in person, he’s one mighty wizard! We’re too scared even to approach his house. The only one of us who dares, is my father, the village leader. You can speak to him, just wait until he returns from the forest, he’s been there since morning. You’re not in a hurry, are you?
Oh my, this is so scary!
Ugh, thank you so much! I can see you’re on business here. Well, if it was Plu the Tightwad who sent you, tell him to get lost! What? You’re not Free Traders, huh? Who are you then?
Get into Nawlad Jeer’s mansion and persuade him to teach you to speak with the dead people.

Ah, so you’ve come to see the boyar? Aren’t you brave! We, peasants, don’t dare to approach his house. I’m the only one who comes inside, you know, to hand in the taxes, or to sort out the documents. To tell you the truth, he’s rather soft, although scary. Never hurts the likes of us. Occasionally, he even does some good wizardry, if you know what I mean. He won’t see anyone in person, though. If we need anything, we have to talk to the servant.

Alright, nothing ventured, nothing gained. See, there’s his house, right there. Talk to the servant, who knows, may be the boyar will agree to see you. Make sure not to drive him mad, though! There was this one girl who strived to learn from him, to which he didn’t agree, so she found no better thing to do, but to sneak into his house through the drain! And we never saw her since!
A month in the cage is a decent lesson, I’ll make sure to remember it well, Jeer!
You also failed to charm secrets out of Jeer? Well, if you know where to seek, you will certainly find what you look for!

All these days behind Jeer's bars haven't been in vain! You can lock up the witch's body, but you can never restrain the witch's soul! While in the fortress, I managed to find out where Jeer's soft spot is! He's going to answer for everything now!

Listen. He really is immortal. I don't know how, but he detached his death and secured it with magic. Until it is set free, he won't have to face it, and thus, won't have to die. Where, do you think, it is hidden? Somewhere in his caskets? No way! On this very allod! Whatever is hidden, can be found!

First of all, you have to be able to see the coffer. Jeer cast a spell to revert the eyes from it, but I know just the way to dispel it. Go to the woods and bring me some good herbs and cold water. I'll tell you what to do next.
How an idea of securing his own death in the middle of the forest could ever come into his moldy head?!
What do you mean - slipped? What duck? I knew nothing of the duck!
Chase the duck and grab Jeer’s death

Easy, calm now... The duck’s flown away? It’s nothing. It cannot disappear from the allod. We only have to catch it before the old man does.

Let me read my cards now. See, it’s so clear: ace of spades next to the jack of diamonds. This means that someone has already caught it. Someone from the village. Hurry to the forest, the hunter must still be there!
Why are you still hanging around? What if the hunter gets the egg before we do?
Here it is, can you see it! Oh, just hold on now, you old rot!
Make Jeer teach you to talk to the dead
Now you’re one important person, aren’t you? Happy learning! Try not to kill him after all, I’ve got to deal with him, too.
If I were a boyar, I’d never leave such a wide pipe unguarded!

Have you drunk in all his knowledge? Good. Now it’s my turn, hand me the needle, if you please. I’ll beat the dust out of the geezer! I’ll make sure he pays back for everything he’s done to me, and the mouldy bread, and the rotten water, and the putrid straw for bed! And most of all, he’s going to pay for his nasty giggles!
Oh shure, of high importance, tell me! It mustabeen Cath'rina who sent you! And Yaska baked you a pie, togetha with Addinas, rye? Leave me alone, before I break your neck!
h: Tell him that your matter is of high importance

t: Alas! The master is sure to kill Mart, he will! Ah well, anyways, come on in, you bloody lunatics! What for are we paying the price of having you here?
Find the mansion of Nomarkh Iblis.

Here! Hurry! Quiet, or they’ll hear us! You are not Iblis’ servant, right? I don’t care, whether you’re from the League or the Empire! What’s being prepared here, will bring harm to everyone in this world. Listen.

I’m from the City Council. I’m tracking down Nomarkh Iblis. Yasker gave him money to develop Spinner technology for the Imperial army. What Iblis did, he started selling the combat machines to everybody! I found his lab on this island, and he turned out to be worse than just a conman.

All Spinners have the in-built remote control listener, which means he’s got his own private army, spread throughout Sarnaut, only waiting to be activated!

Together, we are able to sneak into the mansion. Help me finish him, and I’ll help you... by the way, what is your mission here? Oh, I don’t really care. Deal?

First of all, we have to get inside. There’s a hole in the fense. Then, there is the garden, but it’s not too well secured. Let’s roll!
Quiet! Iblis hears us, unleashes Spinners, and we’re done!
Fine. We’ll come in through the main entrance.
Careful downstairs. A few former Tep’s servants live here, and they all know the code to start Spinners remotely, so you will have to kill them all!
Cultists, mechanoids, now this one... Dirt to dirt, the saying is true...
Half the deed is done. Now it gets more dangerous.

Iblis seems to envy Tep’s fame. Together with the machines that spread all over Sarnaut, he’s preparing another army, which he is going to lead himself. There is a new, improved Spinner’s model behind this door. It will be independent, reinforced, more functional. Luckily for us, it hasn’t been finished yet, so it’s not hard to destroy. But check your equipment, anyway, it won’t be that easy!
Thank goodness! I thought my death hour has come.

Who are you? Who was that brave warrior?

That’s how it turns out to be... I used to despise the Imperials, and now a Xadaganian spy gave her life for my freedom. I guess I must pay off the mortal debt and kill the damned bastard. Do you know what he wanted to do to me? Turn me into a Clockwork knight! Now it’s either him or us!

First of all, we need to get the keys. The sentry officer is keeping them. Let’s start!
Hurry! All guards are going to be here in an instant!
We’re out, thank all gods! I locked the door and broke the key, so they won’t get us.

Science is good. It gave us technologies, ships, different useful devices. On the other hand, look at the monsters it creates. I wish I could live thousand years ago, without iron beasts and deadly mechanisms. That must have been so good...

Ah, dreams. Back to business now. See these iron spiders ahead? You cannot defeat them with your bare hands. I heard Iblis getting after one of his technicians the other day, saying they oughtn’t throw mana batteries to garbage, because Spinners step on them, and batteries explode and pierce through Spinner’s defenses. See their weak spot? Let’s find a few mana batteries and try using them against Spinners, eh?
Why is there always a mess, won’t machines work without it?
Perfect! Let’s try them now. It’s all or nothing...
Destroy three Spinners 1.1 after lifting their defenses.
We can find an unspinnable tie-up for every Spinner, alright! We’ve got enough batteries, let’s remove their defenses now, so that they were easy to disassemble.
I wish they would kill one another...
We did it! Now hold on, Iblis, you’re going to pay for everything!

I can see him! There he is, right behind the gates! That’s it, Iblis, your last hour has come!

Look at them! Iblis riding his iron pony, and the others are staring and clapping their hands! If we attack him, they’ll spring at us all together. We’d better take them in one by one, and then get to Iblis. Sounds like a good plan, huh?
Pride is sin. You take a minute to admire your devices, and get killed instantly!
We did it! Iblis’ evil plans are ruined, victims avenged, and we’re free! If it weren’t for you...

So Catherina needs a drop of my blood? She saved my life, so I guess I can do this little favor. Let’s hurry to Umoir then, I’ve got important business to do. These ruins will take us there in an instant.
Looking for your companion, eh? He’s run off to the Queen already.
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
Sneak to the classified facility’s territory.

I’ve got a lot in my history, but I’ve never intruded a secret base. It’s okay, we can do it. What have we here? Gates, guards, wires... No turrets, no emergency alarm, no guarding spells... Phew, that’s nothing at all! Imperial safety, huh!

We’ll disguise like sentries. I’ll hide here, and you will lure a soldier or an officer. No, we won’t change into someone else’s sweaty uniform. I’ve got a special device, camouflator. You’ll see how it works.
There we go. Going in disguise is a serious crime, by Imperial law.
Ask what tests and experiments are conducted on the allod.
Now let’s find out what the Imperials do here, where they store the anomaly, and the rest. You’re the officer now, so you’re in charge. Go and ask the staff. Make sure not to give yourself away.
Greetings, comrade officer! The project moves on, as scheduled... almost...
Obtain a bottle of surgical spirit for Alex.

We’re meeting the deadline, officer! We ran a test yesterday, and it was sooo... goood... I’m sory, I’m a little dizzy now...

I’d love to show you the machine in action, but the first test run totally corroded the mana reductors’ contacts and both temporal wheels. Now we need pure surgical spirit to avoid hangover... I mean, to clean them and avoid blowing up!

Speaking about hangover... I mean, rubbing contacts! Officer, please, give your order to grant us one big bottle of pure spirit, and I give you my word, we will produce the results today!
We cannot let scientific breakthrough fail only because there is no liquor... I mean, no liquid lubricating oil!
Here it is! This machine will make masters of time from us!
Help Alex prepare the machine for running.

Everything is fixed, the machine is nearly ready. The last thing to do is...

First, last time we ran it, the fuse blew out, we need new ones. Fetch them from the stockmen.

Second, it’s parasites. I’m not speaking about the League, it’s common parasites, bugs that chew and damage the wires. Light forbid, they might eat something vitally important during the experiment. You have to get rid of them.

And third, you have to warn my assistants that we are ready to start.

See, how simple? Very little time left till the important historical moment!
We are on the verge of magitechnical revolution!
Ready! Now we can see ancient Sarnaut - provided we have the official license.
Take part in the historical event.

Now we are going to test run our time machine! This is the first time ever you have a chance to see it in action! We will pierce through time and space! We will move into the past! Centuries into the past!
Who are you, demons? Where’s the master?
Find a hint in Zayan de Desirae’s library.

What is it? An intrusion? How dare you! Do you have any idea whose tower this is?! Magister Zayan will tear you apart... Who are you?

What do you mean - from the future? Do you happen to know that the temporal magic is the most forbidden of all? Are you aware of what punishment awaits you? Provided that you manage not to destroy Sarnaut, of course. Oh dear, what am I going to do without the magister...

Every instant spent in the past adds up to the temporal disbalance and the imminence of temporal paradox! You must go back to your time, and return Magister Zayan here, into anno mundi 4015.

There’s the Reflection Storage on top of this tower. It’s able to repeat any spell that had been cast recently, any spell at all, even the one that opens the Gates of Time. It is secured by magical guards, and I don’t know how to switch them off. We have a huge library in the basement, may be we’ll find the answer there.
Now, now. What are we going to do next?
A secret passage under the mage’s tower! Can you feel the smell of gold? I mean, golden mysteries and enigma! Yes, that’s exactly what I meant.
Such a curious thing! It burns! I wonder if it’s able to morph us into some kind of demons... Ah, whatever. Let’s show it to the smartie.
Wow, what a place! I’d like to keep something apart from memories of this place.
Woe to me, I am going to be punished...

This device is your chance to set everything right. The Magister has already set it up real nice, so even you will be able to use it. I hope.

Keep calm, breathe deeply, count to ten... Step in the center of the hall, stand at the spot where you first appeared... No, I’ll stay right here, I still want to live. And pray... for the repose. Kidding, just kidding!
Is it dangerous? We won’t get to ancient Junes, right?

What have we done! We dragged into the Present great mage Zayan de Desirae himself! He’s thousand years old, and he still lives in the present! It means, we have two of him now, and there is none in the past! What is it now, the temporal paradox, then?

We need to take him back. Let’s find him and secretly return to the past. We need to be really quiet and act covertly! Don’t be scared, I’m not new to this profession.
I wonder what it’s going to be, if Zayan From The Past comes across Zayan From The Future... I’d rather not check that.
There, there. Zayan saved, temporal paradox imminence lifted, pockets full of gold... It’s all right. What, no gold in your pockets? How could you not steal some?!
Ask Semer Khaemweset about problem in the mine.
Who’re you? Nickel finally spent a dime and brough a hero? Listen then, I’ll tell you everything.
Lazy bones, wandering about instead of working!
This place is so gainful! I could earn so much, why do I keep wasting money?!
First ask these fools, driven crazy by the whisper. They’re locked in the storehouse, just in case.
Why would everyone go mad these days?
I thought they’d say something useful, but they seem to be really mad. What are we going to do next?
Go down to the mine and defeat the evil spirits.
Oh well, so now it seems to be your turn to go under ground and see those monsters!
There are thousands of gems under this mountain! I will never let go of it!
Who’s making the noise? Who is Nickel? I’m the mistress of this allod! You will dig only if I let you dig! And if I won’t, you’ll sink into hell!

I know nothing of Nickel! I agreed to let people dig for stones, not for copper! They broke their promise, that’s all for now.
You say, don’t kill the innocent? Look me in the eye now... Oh. I can see a strong heart and a good spirit... Right, I will lift the curse for the first time. As to the Prophetic Ruby, you will have to earn it!
Pass my test first. There’s a stony forest at the allod. I will tell you the magic word for the Pillars to show you the way to the forest. If you find the path through it to my parlor, it means you worth it. And if you don’t - then don’t blame me!
We haven’t received any guests long time!
Ssstop, mortals! I am Mighty Polozsss, the guardian of the Mistress’ chambersss. You must prove worthy before you may enter!
Find replies to the riddles of Mighty Poloz.

You’re strong, and I can now clearly see it. Now show me how clever you are. I will tell you three riddles, and you are to bring me the answers to the riddles.
First riddle. I have scissors for hands and I walk sideways.
Second riddle. I have a little house in which I live all alone. It has no doors or windows, and if I want to go out, I must break through the wall.
Third riddle. White horses stand on a red hill, first they champ, then they stamp, then they stand still.
If you are smart enough, you can guess what it is! Otherwise, you’re not worthy of seeing the Queen!
Any fool can use a sword. Try and use your brain!
Sssssmart, aren’t you? You may passss!
Find the Mistress of the Copper mountain.
The Mistress’ chambers are right behind my back. Make ssssure not to put her into rage, or you will be damn ssssorry!

Not many are able to pass through the forest and reach my chambers. Could it be that the ancient heroes are returning? I’m keeping my promise, here’s the Prophetic Ruby! Now you may go. Return the bill of sale to Goldie. Tell him, I forgive him for the first occasion, but if the agreement will ever be broken again, people will never see the gems again! As for you, forget the path through Stone Woods! You are not welcome any longer!
Find out what's going on here.

It’s a miracle! Lumix isle has always been a cold naked stone, now it’s all fresh springs and blooming trees! Is it the work of a great mage?

Wait, there’s someone else here. Who is that? Gibberlings? No, it’s not. Oh Tensess, it’s the illusory prisoners! What are they doing here? It’s impossible... Victory over Tep was just a dream, and it means we’re still there, in his machine...

Okay, pull together, Claire. Fear is fatal to common sense. We have come to find the source of magic, right? May be the magic that gave them bodies is the same magic that has transformed the allod! Let’s talk to them.
So cold, no food, wild animals... I wonder if we’ll go wild, either...

Who helped us survive after the gods were gone? Who protected and taught us, who healed us, when we were sick? Do you know it was noone but the Wise Crocodile? We ornate his statue and bring him offerings, and he visits us from time to time. We haven’t received him here yet, that’s true, but there is no statue of him, either. A few days ago I proposed making the statue of snow - it is no stone, of course, but it’s good enough for sacrifices. However, there is still no statue, they are still agruing. Why don’t you give them a hand?
I haven’t seen you for ages! Who’s this angry lady?
We meet again! You’ve become stronger now... And I have known now so many things about Irdrich and Sarnaut, that I grew even older now...
See, I was right! You weren’t that wrong, eather. Let’s do it now.
h: Tell them what Genlun looks like

t: Teleport to the other edge of the allod.

Noone can hear me now, but you. No need to scare the others.

There is much magic on this island. Much more than a great mage is able to use.

Now I know the truth about Irdrich, but this allod is a mystery even to me. It is real, and the Tekyan are real. A few days ago they were teleported here from Tequatl - with their houses and all.

But that’s not all. I haven’t arrived at once, because the same power erased my image from their memories. If you arrived a few days later, they would have forgotten me completely.

I don’t who does this. I’m not too strong outside Irdrich. But I can give you a hint where to look for the answer. There is another Tekyan settlement beyond the mountains. I cannot go there, but you can. Find June ruins, teleport there and find out the truth. I give you my blessing.
Helping the idol! What a disgrace.
Look, they’re here, too. And the smell, can you feel the smell of Mirra?
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
I am happy to see you again.
This smell of Mirra, the light, the bliss! Have they accepted the true faith? They might know more than their brothers. We need to talk to them.
Long time no see! How’s everything? I’m trapped, see. And you are about to be lynched by a fluffy horde. Nice day, isn’t it?
Nice! They’re a way more dangerous than they may seem.

Long time no see! Have you searched half the Astral only to find me? It’s flattering. But I don’t have what you need. Hush, this is no time to talk. Remove these chains, and I will give you answers! Provided that we survive...

The storm is coming! The storm like we have never seen before. The one that imprisoned me is arriving...

I can see June amulet on your neck. Good, it means we have a chance. Touch the four pillars to release the old June blood magic power on the enemy!
Who’s that? Another idol? Light bless me.

I don’t understand! This is the servant of the Light? Why do I have to protect myself?

Wasn’t my faith firm enough? Have I done something wrong? Sinned by talking to the crocodile?

I made up my mind. Return to Umoir and leave me here praying for forgiveness and teach the Light to these gibberlings. I hope Catherina will understand.
Take the orange from monkeys and bring it to Che Kak.

Which fruit is the best? The smelliest, the sweetest, the juiciest? The most beautiful and best for health? Without which humanity absolutely won’t do! Thank Genlun, the blessed fruit moved to the allod along with us. Even if we won’t get out of here, we can grow an orange garden of a single seed.

These horrible monkeys! They are making a mess of this place! They’re stealing our fruit, and if they only intended to eat them! No! They’re trowing them at one another, while we’re unable to chase them - see, how short our legs are? All our future is at risk! Don’t let us down, please!
Why do these noisy animals hate Tekyan so much? It might be to set the example for us not to follow!
An orange! Thank Crocodile, it’s an orange! The Tekyan will go on!
Find traces of Klavdia Kalugina in pirates’ Stronghold

Here it is, Jolly Roger bay! A thousand years ago this was sea and a bay, and even back then pirates used to dwell here. They’re not too happy to see us, huh? Let’s talk to my boys, they already know what goes on here.

I give up! Don’t kill me!

Huh, it’s not the thing you easily forget! The fireworks went boom and bang, and then she captured our last ship and sailed off directly to the ship graveyard. It’s pretty clear what she’s looking for - Feint’s treasure. Is she a witch, or something? It’s not for common people, you know.

Hm... Wait a minute! I’ve seen your face... Silberpod, is that you?!.. Eh?..
Search ship graveyard for Klavdia Kalugina.

Some people should think before they speak! Who does he think he is to talk back to Silberpod?! Anyway, he can talk to Tensess’ servants now, we found out everythink we wanted to. Here’s the key to the jumper. Are you ready to take a walk with the dead?

It’s clear that she’s come for Feint’s treasure. There’s a lot in it, not only gold, but rare books, magic artifacts, ancient relics... And the old man was smart enough to bury it in the most dangerous place, where there are no living souls, but plenty of the dead! But we’re not chicken, eh? Unlike the others, right! It’s for the good, we won’t have to share.

As long as there are no more barges, we’ll walk. There are wrecked ships’ jumpers, that’ll take us from allod to allod. They’re locked, but at least, we’ve got the first key, and we’ll somehow manage to find the others.
Look what Merry had in his cache! It’s Feint’s map! Look, there’s the cross - he buried the treasure at the next allod, in Hangmen’s grove!
Search Hangmen’s grove for Klavdia Kalugina and Feint’s treasure.

There’s nowhere else to look for her. Dead or alive, she’s bound to be at the next allod, in Hangmen’s grove. Same place, where old Feint’s treasure is. Both of us are interested in going there. I take the money, you take the girl.

First of all, we need to find her barge. Let’s go over and search the shore.

Silberpod! Damn you! How many people have you put to grave, while looking for Feint’s treasure? Do you want it now? Here it is, to the last coin, all here! Though I’m not the Benny who used to mob the deck! See, what became of me? Come to me! You will be the same!
Portal is hidden behind pale light.
The portal is shimmering and glimmering. Where will it take you? What is Klavdia Kalugina looking for? Go ahead! Find the answers!
Woe! Woe! Robbers are here! Help us!
Exchange the bird for the horse? That will do! Where’s the horse then?
Find the magic horse for Nikodim Bachelor.

Oh you damned flea bag! Blast you, may the stones fall from the sky upon your head! To eat the best horse in whole Umoir! In whole Sarnaut! May your tooth fall out, and fur come off!

Well, no horse - no bird... Um, but if you get to think of it, the horse was not the only one, it gave life to two foals. One stayed with Makar, the other was sold to Mira Hooves. You may talk to him, try to persuade him... You get the horse, I’ll give you the bird, deal’s still on. Or you may lock the wolf in the cage, instead!
You have to earn a horse like this one! I bought it, true, but you’ve never even seen so much money!
Save the girl from Demonologist and take her to Mira Hooves.

The third task is hard. There’s a demonologist here, so vile and pitiless! He’s nesting on an allod where the Southern Reed used to be. He gave us no trouble, until one day he decided to steal a girl from us. That girl he chose turned out to be my fiancee! Go to the Crossroads to the June stone, it’ll teleport you to the Ruins. Talk to my adepts, they’ll port you to any place you like in an instant! Defeat the Demonologist, set my baby free - don’t get them wrong! If you bring her back alive, I’ll give you Roan as reward!
Wizards like him foul our good reputations!
You’re alive! I gave up hoping to see you alive!
Obtain Roan, exchange it for Firebird and return to Umoir.
What horse? I couldn’t have promised my Roan to a beggar like you. You’re imagining things. Hit the road, or I’ll get angry and throw you into the Astral!
Three indecent old farts in one day! Holy Tensess, why are you punishing me this way?
That’s it. All over. All villains punished, Zalesky Posad is quiet and peaceful once again. Come back any time, you are always welcome.

The letter seems to be full of despair. A grave threat is over Umoir. What's more, it looks like the source of the Leper has been found, and it's time to put an end to it!

Go to Vseslav immediately, and do whatever he asks you to.
You have come! I am very grateful for you to have come, and glad to see you. A misery has come to our land. Have you heard about the Ancient Mound?
Enter the Mound and look at the situation.

Three days ago our druids announced that the Ancient Mound is spreading the Leper. We went to take a look, and saw the freshly dug ground. There were undead all around, and there is nothing we can do about them. We don't even know who their Master is. We have to enter the Mound and kill whoever there is...

Peace between Guards and Outlaws is what we want. We will fight together and wash off all insults with blood! I'm only afraid too much of our blood might spill...

You are always welcome at Umoir, because you are brave and able to deal with all kinds of monsters. Come and take a quick look, what goes on there. Even if you come across something dangerous, I'm sure, you will return safe and sound.

This is the ghost of the witch from the Mound. You can barely see her...

She seems to have lost strength after the Mound fight, and she even cannot speak...
Find the ancient artifact in Plagot ruins and bring it back to the witch.

The oracle looks you in the eye, and familiar pictures fly in front of you: Plagot Ruins, Ancient relics, ghostly demonic figures, brave warriors... Finally, the picture shapes into a sharp image of one of the artifacts from the ruins. It looks like a cross... no, more like a handy grip of an old sword, generously decorated. This is curious.

Well, a debt is a debt to pay. Who knows, may be she'll talk again?
Eyeing you silently, and looks like a ghost.

Ancient magic is like water in desert for me. I though it was the end... We're even now, I hope.

You oughtn't know my name. Ancient names are best left forgotten - it's dangerous to rip up old wounds, you know. One thing I'm craving for is peace. I only had to pay my last debt to my comrades here, in the Mound. A Demon is eating their souls as we speak, so I am willing to tear the awful beast apart, and free their souls! I have no doubt that you want the same.
Tell the King about the ghost's words.

Yes, this is the sword. It used to belong to a brave wandering knight. I knew him when I was alive... The charmed steel seems to remember the taste of my blood. Now it's falling into nothing, see? Its life is also over...

Let us not dwell in the past now. Our aim is to clean the Mound from demonic filth. You want to save the living. My purpose is to save the dead. We can do it together.

The undead in the Mound are half the problem. They are strong, all right, but completely brainless, so it's not really hard to defeat them, regardless of their numbers or how terrifying they are. The power that stands behind them, is a thousand times worse. Talk to the King, he will tell you more - his people were here yesterday.

Meanwhile, I will deal with the ghosts. It's time for them to rise and protect Umoir, as the ancient prophets predicted. After the final battle they and I will rest in peace. Don't reveal my presence. It is not time yet...

It's so easy to say - we need an army at the Mound! If I only had an army, I wouldn't trouble you. We did sign a peace treaty with the soldiers, but Outlaws and Guards aren't on a friendship terms... This is comprehensible, of course. Each of them has blood of the other side on their hands...
Call Outcasts in the Covert Hide and Catherina's guards in the Lower City to peace and report to the Ghost at the Ancient Mound.

Here's what I'm thinking. If this paper is so important for this world, why don't you use it? Everyone from the both sides respect you greatly, so you are naturally going to become and ambassador. You will tell them that the disaster is near, and that they all must obey the peace treaty... You know the politics better than I do.

There are many smart guys among them. Some will surely believe you. Talk to the outcasts in the Covert Hide, then go speak with Catherina's guards in the Lower City...

Only time will tell if I am right or wrong, but I'm sure we can work it out.

Is this the army of the living? This is bad... They will flee, just as soon as they see the undead... All they can do is brag. But we still have hope. They can't see me, so don't you give away that I'm here... and listen carefully.
Collect pagan amulets in Plagot ruins, set fire on nine ancient menhirs near the Mound and report to the ghost.

See those menhirs around the Mound? They conceal huge power. This power restricts and protects the spirits of the Mound. It's like a prison and a sweet home at the same time. If we manage to subdue this power, we will be able to call all the dead people here, just like blowing in a horn. They will rise! They will rise to defend their home.

In each menhir there is a slot, the shape of which reminds ancient defensive pagan amulets, that were used centuries ago. You will have to find all nine of them. We shouldn't underestimate them - they absorbed suffering of these lands and blood of the citizens... They will help us call upon a huge army - an army of the ancestors.

I hope we can bring the two parties to peace. If not the King's order, then it's only the word of ancestors that'll help. Go and beware. The spirits might be dangerous.
Hurry, we don't have much time.
We succeeded! The dead and the living will fight elbow to elbow! This is not anything you achieve every day. Just the sight of it should make the enemy run in terror!

Ah well, it's time to go. It looks like I will finally return my bloody debt, after so many centuries. I swear to follow you into the heart of the Ancient Mound, and burn the filth and evil with iron and the rightful word! Excuse my tears, I'm sensitive about my past...

We need to break through the first line of Demon's defense. I bet he never expected us to stand up to him this fast. At least, our troops are quite independent now.

Beware, the undead are unpredictable. This victory will be rather easy, but it's just the beginning. Nobody knows how it will be...

Well done. It's the first step. They fought together, not against each other.

The army is not going inside the Mound. They will look for the remaining undead here, at the surface, and will keep them restricted. You have the most difficult task ahead of you.
Defeat Jam or Zomgie, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

The time has come. Before the Demon has a chance to raise a new army, we need to enter the tomb and challenge him! Your path lies through the thicket, full of the undead. What is worse, there are only two ways to the tomb, and both of them are deadly dangerous.

One lies through the dead water. A huge ancient toad called Jam lives there. It was perilous even before the Leper, now is has turned into a real monster. You can judge by its name, it speaks for itself. Jam! It's jamming you and crushing your bones and flesh. Beware of its mighty croak, too. If you can, do not let it give a croak at all, if you can.

The other road leads through the burial grounds, where an ancient monster dwells. He once used to be a powerful necromancer, I think, Tep was is name... Oh, wait, I can see you're familiar with the name, aren't you? Now the monster by the name Zomgie is able to make all dead men rise from their graves. It will be extremely difficult to fight him, especially provided that there's a huge cemetery around. The pleasant surprise is that the corrupted carnivorous plants don't like the living dead too much, so Nature is going to be your ally in this war against Death.

Choose your path wisely! And take this trinket. Use it to summon me at any time! I will be with you all the time, and I'll try and warn you, if something goes wrong. Best of luck to you!

Battle with Jam will be long and exhausting, but if you are careful enough and don't forget to look upwards, you will surely avoid certain death. Zomgie dwells in the burial grounds, so you may go that way and find him. Watch carefully what he's looking at. His gaze is deadly.

It is quite obvious that the Ancient Mount is the very place, where the Leper is coming from, its heart, so to say.

On the bright side, we now know for sure that we have got to the heart of the matter!
Defeat Eye Stare, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

Now it's time to face the most dreadful Leper's creature. To tell you the truth, it's not only Leper who gave him birth. Listen...

Eye Stare is one of the oldest treants in this place. Long ago he got mixed up with the magic of death. His fellow treants drove him away, into the burial grounds, but this was exactly what he needed! Plenty of dead bodies to raise, plenty of restless souls to let them into his body. So, after a while he got an idea that he was a local king of the undead. When the Leper came, he gladly and easily let it in, too. He became a loyal servant of the Demon. Peasants were calling him Asura, a one-eyed monster, now his name is Eye Stare.

What really troubles me, is his ability to turn invisible and strike from behind. He may interfere into somebody's mind, even yours or one of your party members, so beware. Try using ashes from urns here to reveal him, but be fast. The longer he stays disguised, the stronger he becomes.
Of course, Eye Stare couldn't fail to get himself some minions! He called upon the dead, and they raised to his call. They may become invisible, too, but luckily, ashes reveal them as well.

That's how Eye Stare gets himself guised! He had an ancient relic on him, a magical cape, which, by the way, I have seen before. Destiny's sense of humor is indeed... peculiar.

Here's another joke. While you were fighting Eye Stare, guess who entered the Mound! Morrana herself. With a scroll of Tensess in her hands!
Defeat Morrana, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

When I was alive, I was a witch myself. I knew my limits, though, and I knew my powers. Morrana is not a little bit like me...

Her powers are huge. Local peasants call her a Goddess of Death. She sent so many woes and diseases onto these lands, so many people and farm animals died - you can never count! Her might even overcomes that of some great mages themselves! I've been thinking over it for so long, until I finally understood!

The scroll of Tensess! The ancient scroll of immense power. I have seen it when I was alive. It brought so many miseries to people, albeit it bears the name of the greatest! Morrana uses it to increase the power of her wicked spells. I have no idea, however, where the scroll came from, how she laid her hands on it and why she brought it to the Ancient Mound. She might have wanted to enslave the Demon and get his might... Naive fool!

In any case, we have a chance to obtain the scroll. It will give us might large enough to defeat the Demon. Let us kill two birds with one stone: get rid of the witch and get the scroll!
The best way to fight a witch this strong is to turn her magic upon herself! Take a good look around before the battle starts. There might be something useful nearby.
Morrana has a lot of loyal servants near her. All of them are vulnerable to her own magic. Too much magic may play a dirty trick on you!

She's not the first to have fallen on the account of her self-assuredness! And not the last one. Wether it is for the good or for the bad, only time will show.

This is half way. The exit to the inner chamber is open now. Look out now, even I do not know what dangers lie ahead. Greatest warriors and most skillful mages are buried in these tombs. Demon will surely summon them for battle! On the other hand, not every creature it summons is that loyal to it...
Defeat Brainum the Third, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

Speaking about the next enemy, I cannot help but giggle. Demon resurrected good old stupid cyclops, willing to add up a strong and dumb killing machine to the army. He made a grave mistake, though. Brainum is really strong, but his greed equals to his strength. He's in the treasure room at the moment, and it doesn't look like he's leaving it!

Of course, we could leave him to the locals. There are plenty of them to beat him by numbers. Unfortunately, the treasure room is the only way that leads to the tombs, and we don't have enough time to wait while they do it for us...

Brainum was stupid, while he was alive. Now Brainum's got no brain at all. Don't turn your back on him, mind you. Just one blow, and you're a wet spot on the ground! My advise is to split and take positions in different corners of the treasure room. His attention will be distracted, and he will be running about the room... crashing and crushing everything that's in his way, shooting a magic beam from his eyes. Look around, you might find something that will help you bring him to reason.

There's another danger I want you to remember about. If Brainum goes really mad, he's able to crush rocks and stones! Mind you, he's totally capable of ruining the whole tomb you're in. Don't let him concentrate on just one target. Distract him all the time.

Ogres, trolls, cyclops... I even find their dumbness somewhat charming, you know. Just imagine, what it would be like, if Brainum had brains? With his strength, he could destroy... basically, everything.

The tombs are near. There's just the final obstacle...
Defeat Corrupted Sirin, then report to the Ancient Ghost.

We are close to the center of the Mound, Heroes' tombs. One last guardian awaits ahead.

Have you heard about a bird of sorrow, Sirin? Two mystical birds lived here, in Umoir. One called Gamayun, always sang songs of happiness and joy, while songs of the other bird, called Sirin, told you about sweet sorrow and hard lessons taught by the past.

I have been thinking, I couldn't understand what made Sirin hide in these catacombs, and then I realized! It was Catherina who imprisoned her in this gloomy place. Sirin was destined to sing about all the evil deeds of the queen, and predict the end of Umoir. Who would possibly enjoy hearing this?

Unfortunately, Sirin stayed here for too long. The Demon's impact corrupted her body and mind. Now her songs are full of poison, and all she goes on about is death, suffering and death... We must rid her of this torture.

If she manages to fly high, it will be pretty hard to defeat her - but will give her an easy victory. Try using her poisonous slime on her, this might help.
All birds keep their feathers clean. If you smear them with her own slime, it will distract her from flying up. She will furiously beat her wings then, and it's the best moment to strike!

Sirin was singing songs of sorrow and despair, shredding souls and seeking secrets deep inside... I need to tell you the truth I've been hiding from you.

Raniesta is my name. A long long time ago I first came to the allod of Umoir together with my sworn brothers and sister. We were seeking to find out what happened to the great mage Skrakan. We saw a lot. We walked many roads together. We fought shoulder to shoulder...

I betrayed them. Betrayed by friends, my brothers... for a scroll and a cape...
Defeat the Primal Demon and give peace to ancient heroes: Danas, Fergard and Naira.

What are the scroll and the cape, you ask? Tensess himself gave them to Skrakan. Why? For what purpose? Do not ask me... I suppose, Tensess was willing to protect Skrakan during his experiment, which started this all - the great mage summoned the ancient demon to Umoir, and everything has gone out of the way. The Leper started back then, do you not understand? My friends stopped it. They defeated the demon and laid him for his infinite rest.

At least, I thought it was infinite. But then this stupid girl Catherina returned the damned creature to life, and all began from the start. Which is even worse, my friends, Danas, Fergard and Naira, were buried here together with their worst enemy. Umoir citizens back then believed that this was the way to protect themselves from the corruption of the demon and his magic. That was a grievous mistake. Now the three of them are demon's slaves for the rest of eternity.

I beg you to put an end to their sufferings. Please! And beware, they are strong warriors, and it won't be easy to defeat them. Besides, Demon will surely grant them a piece of his disgusting power. The scroll and the cape will help you in the battle. Use the scroll to break the connection between the heroes and the demon. The cape will protect you from the deadliest attacks and spells.

May the luck be with you! I will be praying for you... there's nothing else left for me to do.
There was a glorious hero with us. He was a pilgrim, a paladin. His sword ended my life, when I deceived my friends. His sword brought me back to life. Fate works in mysterious ways...

The Demon is defeated!

Praise you! And praise the ancestors. If it weren't for you, who knows, what would have happened to Umoir... and to the world.

We can defeat the remaining undead all together with the outcasts and the guards. Your help is always welcomed, but needed no more! If great deeds await, you may go now. We are eternally grateful to you, hero.
Use the hull cannons to repel the attack of Architects and meet Izbor Yavorsky on the bridge of Eclipse.

Wait... I'll be damned! That thing on the horizon is definitely an Architects' Ship! How does that ugly machine fly at all?

It looks like they want to confront us in a ship combat. Alright, let's see what their cannons are capable of!

Go to the cannon deck and give some hell to the bastards! But watch out for the temperature - the cannons easily overheat.
You are a precise shooter, friend! Look, they run in terror!
Enter the Distortion and alter the time to save the bombers and make them complete their mission, then talk to Stomp the Merciless.

The space around the body distorts and shifts. Looks like the time goes in a wrong direction... It's just like it was in the White Fortress when Archont used some weird magic, which Klavdia called "Temporal", and that temporal loop somehow saved Unn!

What did she say about the Pattern of Destiny? That it can be changed, and then the whole Tissue of Creation will change! Maybe we should risk?
Have you found the missing bombers?
Talk to Izbor Yavorsky in the northern Steel Scythe.
Some of our guys will stay here to clear the coast, and another group has already reached the top to hold the line up there. Izbor leads them. Go to him, don't worry about us.
Greetings! You are even a better fighter than they say you are!
Use the jumping device on the deck, destroy the Architects' assault forces on the fleet ships and return to Crazystorm the Merciless on Eclipse.

It looks like the bastards are going to assault our ships. There is no way they are going to break through to Eclipse - Catherina surely took care of it, but the rest of the fleet ships are going to have some hard time unless we hurry up. No one but you has faced the Architects before! The others may just freak out as soon as they see them. So we pin our hopes on you again.

There is a jumping device on the deck, which you can use to reach the next ship. And you better hurry up!
Hurry! The Architects are about to assault the ship!

Hey, we gave some hell to those mechanical parasites!

Ha! It looks they're not so almighty, after all.
Go to the assault deck of Eclipse, board the lifeboat and reach the shore of Dane.

Get ready for landing! We launch Operation D. Why D? Hell if I know!

Here's the disposition: the defensive fortifications are located on the sand shore of the allod. Previously they were used to repel the attacks of Astral pirates, but now they are occupied by the enemy forces. The Architects are going to furnish resistance and will try to bring down the ships as we approach the shore, so you keep your eyes wide open!

The mission of the assault troops is to suppress the shore defenses of the enemy and provide the Alliance ships with a safe landing ground.

Is everything clear? Then go, to the landing deck!
That's one heavy touchdown! Are you okay?
Find Ingrid's brothers - Ulrich and Brand, complete their quests and return to the Salty family.

That was one hell of a fight - half of our fighters are knocked out! I thought you had one foot in the Purgatory, but you are really a die-hard.

My brothers, Ulrich and Brand, went out scouting and never came back. If you still can fight, please look for them. Meanwhile, I will take care of the rest of the soldiers.

Watch out for the damned stone bastards!
Take a closer look at the "peepers", destroy the thrashers and return to Ulrich the Salty.

Hey, keep it quiet!

While I was hiding here, I noticed those little stones. Some of them look like eyes that seem to be staring at our ships all the time! And others have little arms - they rush to attack if they sense even a slightest movement. I'd say it is rather suspicious, if you ask me.

Why don't we take a closer look at the peepers and the "armed” ones, too? Can you do that? I will go check on my sis, she must be worried.
So, have you found out what those stone eyes are?

So these flying peepers are aiming their guns at our ships?! Damned buggers!

So if one eye sees something, the rest of the army sees it, too? I think we are in trouble...
Search the wreckages on the Steel Scythe, find a rope and pull Brand the Salty out of the cleft.

They almost tore me to pieces, those ugly jerks. I was lucky to be that small to fit in this crack and hide from them!

But now I'm stuck. I can't get out on my own.

No, don't even think of getting down here, or we'll end up stuck together. You better find some rope. Anything will do. Look, the whole beach is covered with ship wreckages!
Rope. Find a rope and get me out of here!

Phew! Thank you!

I should get back to my sister. You come, too - we need to figure out what to do next.
Use the smoking jars to get closer to the fortification, climb on it and destroy the Architect.

We helped those who we could. May the Light shine upon the path of the rest of them! We need to move on.

It's just, there's some wretch sitting in the tower and shooting at everything that moves. It's pretty precise, too. So we can't make it past the tower before we get rid of it.

We have a couple of vials with magic smoke. It's so thick you can't see your own hands in it! We can use it as a cover to get closer to the tower. There we will just climb the ladder and cut the monster to pieces!

Brothers... Brothers! Ulrich! Brand! They're deeead!!

Bastards!! I hate you!! Why?!!
Launch the signal rocket on the shore of Steel Scythe, wait for the boats to moor and talk to Stomp the Merciless.

Oh my! What am I going to do without me brothers?!

...

Here, take this signal rocket. Launch it on the shore. We need to get our soldiers here as soon as possible, so they can turn those murderers into a pile of dust! How... How can I live without my brothers? Aah...

Hello, soldier! I'm Stomp, Crazystorm's brother. You know, he's kinda the commander, and I'm, like, the chief guerilla, huh!

Come on, lay out the disposition. Who are we beatin' up and where?
Keep fighting the Architects until the rest of the guerillas arrive, then talk to Stomp the Merciless.

Oops! It looks like we are not welcomed here. What is the best way to kill an Architect, you say?

Any will do? That's good. We just need to hold on until the assault lifeboats reach the shore.

You take care of it, and meanwhile, I will help our soldiers moor.
Beat them! Our guys are about to disembark!
It's been long since I was in a decent fight!
Destroy the Architects who guard the northern fortification, and find Sarang Kheket.

Here is what I think. See those towers? Some nasty critters sit there and fire at our ships. We will take care of the first tower. The second one was supposed to be blown up by our bombers, but something must have gone wrong.

Take my men and go there. Kill the Architects and find out what happened to the damned goblins and the bombs!
Looks like that's the Arisen that was giving orders to the bombers. His body is crippled and deformed... Poor fellow.
Looks like that's the Arisen that was giving orders to the bombers. His body is crippled and deformed... Poor fellow.
Launch 5 gibberlings on air balloons and speak with Scaggy Black.

See those deflated air balloons? Previously, they were used to watch over the Astral shore and locate pirate ships. But we can use them to watch over the allod! If we rise high enough, we can even see the Iron City, the capital of Dane!

I sent several scouts to keep their eyes on the enemy, but they don't seem to be handling it well. Can you help them?
We need somebody to keep the watch on the balloons!
Oops! Something went wrong. The balloon won't fly...
Search the area around the lighthouse, find fuel for the burner and return to Scaggy Black.

Ha - the burner's broken! And there's no fuel left. What do we do now?

If I were a Free Trader, where would I store fuel? In a place with a roof and walls, like that lighthouse over there!

Let me fix the burner, and you search the lighthouse.

Wait a second... Something's not working. Alright, I'll try and figure it out. Thank you!

Maybe I need to turn the tap? Clockwise or counter-clockwise? Who knows...
Kill 10 Soulless Ones near the Lighthouse and return to Izbor Yavorsky.

Hahaha! Everyone's dead, dead! We are dead! Hahaha!

Stone is flowing. Like sand, hahaha! And lightning! And ice! And time - all flowing!

Then HE came! HE came, do you hear it?! Hush... Listen... That's it! Eyes, silver in the eyes. Light, light!
You are looking strange. Are you alright?

Well-well. Deprived of souls? How can you even deprive a living thing of a soul? I've never heard of such a thing! Maybe, she's just bonkers? And those unfortunates that you had to kill were just out of their minds, not deprived of their souls?

Oh, I don't know. I have more pressing issues. We need to get to the city, that's what's bothering me now.
Soul... Where is my soul?! Have you seen it?

Eyes! They stare, and stare, and then the light. And my soul - phew! My soul's gone! Hahaha! Looking for the soul, hahaha! The soul's gone, HE took it. HE sees everything! Where there was lighthouse, now HE is!

Time! Time heals, heals the souls. When time isn't flowing, the soul isn't living. Ahaha! Sparks are scattered around, oh...

HE! HE is looking! And seeing everything!
Clear the river bank of the Architects, find shelters for the cannoneers, launch the signal rockets and return to Izbor Yavorsky.

The Architects have retreated from the shore and regrouped. The river separates us from the city, and the enemy has occupied the opposite bank, though there are plenty of Architects on this side, too. We won't make it without some serious support.

Our Imperial allies provided us with several light cannons. We don't have any experience in working with such machinery, but the gibberlings swear they will easily figure it out. We need to find good shelters to allocate the cannon section. I assign this task to you!
Find suitable locations for the cannon section and make sure the area is clear of enemies. Launch a red rocket when you are ready!
The cannoneers have already set out to the locations you'd found. I hope they can make it unnoticed, otherwise our plan is screwed.
Lure Shieldsmasher to the bridge, sound the siren and destroy the Architect, then meet Stomp the Merciless in the Shore City harbor.

Me and Stomp have decided that our best strategy is to try and break into the city from two directions. Stomp will take his troopers to the harbor and will hold the fort. Meanwhile we have to handle the enemy on the other side of the river and near the city gates. There's just one problem... There is a huge Architect right behind this bridge. Arrows and spells just don't work against him. Maybe we should try artillery?

Will you take up this task? I knew you would. Take this siren. Lure the Architect to the bridge and then sound it - our cannoneers will take him out right away!
Huh, you're fast! I hope you're finished with the Architects on then river bank?
Huh! What was that sound? They are using our cannons, aren't they? I told them that their spells are useless!
Destroy 10 Vigilant Eyes in the Shore City harbor and report to Stomp the Merciless.

Look! Not at me, to the harbor! Do you see those round eye-like things? I don't like them. Why are they staring at us?

Listen, why don't you get rid of them? They seem like a pain in the neck.
We don't need Architects' spies here!
Destroy mana pipelines on the shore and return to Arrow the Sylvan.

I am Arrow, and she is Lucille. Stomp has sent us to find out who fired at Eclipse. They have completely destroyed the portside shield!

And can you imagine - there are those empty-eyed dummies everywhere, and some creatures that seem to be controlling them. They are firing the major caliber at our ships, those morons! I can tell an Imperial cannon when I see one.

And also I know if we don't stop it, they will shatter half of our fleet. There must be mana pipelines supplying the cannons. No mana - no fire. Am I being clear?
The bastards can fire. But can they fix mana pipes? Huh!
What did I tell you? You break one tiny part, and the whole cannon falls apart. The idiots won't fix it in ten years, huh!
Use Sparkton Pack to pull the Sparks out of the Soulless and the Exarkhs on the shore, and return to Lucille de Desirae.

War, war... Everyone just wants to kill the enemy, and it doesn't cross anybody's mind that you can also study the enemy!

No, I'm not a pacifist - I realize perfectly that's it's either we kill them, or they kill us. But my research can become a weapon. If we understand what the Architects and the Soulless are, we can find a way to defeat them!

First, I want to know if they have Sparks. Won't you help me? Here, take this Sparkton Pack. Just aim and push the button!
Come on! I need their Sparks to develop the perfect weapon!

So, what do we have? A bunch of Sparks. Humm... Completely identical Sparks. This is impossible!

A Spark of every creature is unique. Even Gorluxor could only copy the bodies, not the Sparks. It looks like we are on the brink of a great discovery!
Use the Mind Twister to subjugate one of the Soulless on the shore, and return to Lucille de Desirae.

To either confirm or reject my hypothesis, we need something more than just a Spark. We need a living Soulless!

Do you think they are capable of surrendering? Do they know fear? I really doubt that. So we need to trick them.

Look, it's called the Mind Twister. We use on apes in the lab... It suppresses their will, and I think it will work on the Soulless as well.
Just aim it at a Soulless and press the button - they will follow you wherever you will go.

Oh... It's one of our troopers! What is he doing here? Just look in his empty and lifeless eyes... It gives me the creeps.

I tend to believe that a Spark consists of the vital energy and the soul. The soul is instincts, memory, reflexes - everything that constitutes a personality. Without a soul, a Spark is just a clot of energy that moves a body like a puppet. I think we are dealing with a puppet without a soul...

The Architects managed to erase the personality somehow. Ah, that's horrific. Do you realize what it means? A man without a soul does not believe in the Light, and thus cannot be resurrected. This is crazy...

I will continue my research and will find a way to fight them! I promise to keep in touch.
Go to Dubovo Farm and meet Ivan Panfilov's squad.
Look around the sites of battle between the mercenaries and the Architects in the Shore City and find some remains. Return to Sarbaz Ahera.

You know what surprises me? I see traces of battle everywhere, but there is not a single body! I don't think that the defenders managed to carry away all of them. If only we could find just one body, then I could resurrect them and we could learn the truth.

When you are in the town, could you please take a look around? Maybe you will find some remains...
A dead body would be priceless right now.

What is it? I told you I need a dead body, not a handful of sand!

However... What if it was left from an Architect? Hum... What do I do with it?
Find 10 boxes with supplies in the Shore City harbor and bring everything that the soldiers might need. Return to Fedor Lozkin.

Comrade! Comrade! Do you have a minute?

See those boxes on the pier? As far as I remember, ships with food, metal, clothes and other goods used to sail out from the Shore City... Do you think we should let it all rot, or we could appropriate it for the common good? I think so, too!

If you find a medicine box, bring it to me right away! I need one desperately right now.
Bring everything you find, I will take care of it!
Great job, comrade! Now our soldiers will have enough food, clothes and shoes - thanks to you.
Find survivors in the Shore City and escort them to a safe harbor, then return to Stomp the Merciless.

Sarbaz Ahera asked you to search for bodies? Huh! I always knew she's out of her wits. We need to search for survivors! They couldn't have killed everybody.

If you find anyone, get them here as soon as possible. We need to know what happened.
What? They don't want to come?! Are they crazy? Ah, I don't have time to waste on those idiots. We have a mission here.

Get away! Don't touch me, you demon! Your words won't confuse me!

May the Light save us...
You say the harbor is safe? As if I would believe it! The monsters are coming from there. I will hide here until the reinforcement from the Iron City arrives!
None of this would have happened in Nezebgrad...
Obtain 15 handfuls of Architects' remains and return to Sarbaz Ahera.

This is not enough material to study. I saw the other "eyes" that you destroyed fell into pieces. Maybe these are remains of some other Architects?

We need to conduct a comparison study to put together a typology. What are the first principles of a researcher? Typification, correlation, unification! The more we know about the Architects, the easier we can defeat them. So bring me all pieces and fragments you can find - they will all make use!
We've seen too few Architects to be able to classify them. But I am working on that!

Let me see... This is quite curious! Is this a piece of a claw of a part of an eye?

By the way, there is nothing like that dust you found before. Maybe those were some other Architects! I better start with classsification. Well, well...
Find Rita Osanina's husband and return to her.

When the city was attacked, we hid in the basement. I don't know how long it's been... And the Yegor told me to sit quiet and went to see what was going on. He said there were sounds of battle near the town hall, and he was going to reach our soldiers and then come back for me... But he didn't.

Find him, please! He is tall and handsome... And he wears a wedding ring with the sun stone. You will recognize it at once!

I will wait here... and pray.
Come on, answer me! Where is he?

This is Yegor's ring! So he's... No! No, this can't be!

I will... I will avenge him! I will go to the soldiers and take any weapon - a bow, a sword, a spear - I don't care! And if they don't give it to me, I will smother the bastards with my bare hands!
Find the mercenaries in the Shore City, help them defeat the Architects and meet their commander in the town hall.

You say, she mentioned the town hall? If there are survivors, we need to find them. I can't go, I need to watch over the rookies, and I won't trust the doctor lady with the mission. Will you go?

Go on, be careful. We need to find out as much as possible.

Holy Light! I thought nobody would come for us. Has Ivan sent you? No? Then who?!

Tell me everything!

Stop! Who goes there?

Are you from the Iron City?
Alright, we don't have time for chatting. Take you sword and slay the bastards! We can talk afterwards...
Destroy 7 Architect Converters in the Shore City and return to Mikhail Furzikov in the town hall.

The League and the Empire have joined in an Alliance? I can't believe this! And they are here to help us? Oh my!

We've already lost hope... But now we know it's worth fighting!

There are too few of us left. We barely have enough people to hold the barricades, and the enemies are pushing in. There are especially large Architects among them - they seem to be controlling the smaller ones. Once you kill a big one, the small ones lose their vigor. If could help us get rid of the giants, we'd be very grateful!
If you see a huge monster with three legs - kill it at the spot!
See, we threw them back from the barricades! Thank you so much. Every minute of rest is priceless for us.
Reach the anti-ship squadron on the shore to the east from the Shore City, kill all enemies in your way, and find out what happened.

Oh my! It's the shore squadron firing!

But... there were no survivors!

Who is doing that? What are they firing at? At the Alliance fleet?!

I think we can handle it here on our own, and you should go there and find out what is going on.
Hey, get over here! Make sure those empty-eyed don't see you - it seems that they are firing the cannons.
Kill Architects on Dubovo Farm, find Klochkov's body and the papers that the commander gave him.

Come on, there is nothing you can do to help me... A giant monster simply ground us down to dust! I fainted and thus stayed alive - it must have thought I was dead. And now I crawled here, but I won't last long...

The Colossus went on to the city. Find our bomber, Vasily Klochkov, if he is still alive. Our commander gave him some important papers before he died. Find them...

The body is utterly disfigured. Only a blood-covered envelope in the jacket pocket evidences that it was Klochkov.

The oiled envelope contains a heap of papers. One of them is an order to hold back the Architects at any cost and blow up the bridge if necessary, signed by Furzikov. The rest of the scraps and torn pieces of papers are soldiers' goodbye letters. A sad correspondence...
Collect several handfuls of the crushed stone on the battlefield in Dubovo Farm, enter the time Distortion and return to Sarbaz Ahera.

A pile of fine crushed stone, suspiciously reminiscent of the substance that was found on the combat sites in the Shore City. Maybe Sarbaz Ahera can define the origin of this matter after all? This must be something important.

But the Alliance mission has to be completed in the first place.
Haven't I sent you to the shore?
Oh... I hope Panfilov’s guys will resurrect since the Architects haven't destroyed their bodies!
Enter the Time Distortion in Dubovo Farm and help Ivan Panfilov's soldiers in battle with the Architects. Return to Mikhail Furzikov.

Again! Here, just like on the Steel Scythe or in the White Fortress, time is powerless. The space around the hero’s body starts to melt and flow. What if you could change the course of time once again? What if you could save Panfilov's squad, or at least help them fulfill their mission?

Go ahead!
The Architects are attacking! I've sent Ivan Panfilov's squad to hold them back while we are setting up defenses. I hope the squad will survive that.

The bridge has collapsed? But it was... It was our only way to contact the capital!

And what happened to Panfilov's squad? They all died?! It can't be... It turns out I sent them to their doom, and they accepted it resignedly! They all fell, but they fulfilled their mission... Such a heroism! Each one of them deserves a medal. I only hope they return from the Purgatory...
Find Khuus-Juchi and Khuus-Shosha near the Copper lake.

We must get into the city and redeploy the troops there as soon as possible!

I didn't expect that you would blow up the bridge, but I suspected that it could be blocked by the enemy - that's why I sent several scouting groups to find other ways around. Unfortunately, they found nothing. Though one group still hasn't returned - the one I sent to the Copper lake.

Long ago, when there was no bridge, they used to transport goods between the Iron and the Shore cities across the Copper lake on a ferry. The ferry station has been long abandoned, but Khuus-Juchi hasn't returned, which means he either found something, or something happened to him!
Ah, a swamp, what a nasty place, eysh! I swear on my ancestors, here we will sooner come across some swamp monster than a boat.
